decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before leaving a vehicle parked on a street or highway, shut off its engine, lock the ignition, take ____.
cards.back: Before leaving a vehicle parked on a street or highway, shut off its engine, lock the ignition, take the key and apply the brakes.
cards.memory_hook: the key and apply the brakes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook also recommends closing the windows and locking the doors ____.
cards.back: The handbook also recommends closing the windows and locking the doors when leaving a parked vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: when leaving a parked vehicle

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a two-way highway, park parallel to the curb or road edge and ____.
cards.back: On a two-way highway, park parallel to the curb or road edge and no farther than twelve inches away.
cards.memory_hook: no farther than twelve inches away

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before parallel parking, check behind you; if a vehicle follows too closely, continue to ____.
cards.back: Before parallel parking, check behind you; if a vehicle follows too closely, continue to another space instead of stopping abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: another space instead of stopping abruptly

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Begin parallel parking by signaling and stopping with your vehicle’s rear aligned with the rear of the ____.
cards.back: Begin parallel parking by signaling and stopping with your vehicle’s rear aligned with the rear of the vehicle ahead of the desired space.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle ahead of the desired space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For right-curb parallel parking, reverse slowly while steering right to aim your rear ____.
cards.back: For right-curb parallel parking, reverse slowly while steering right to aim your rear toward the vehicle behind the space.
cards.memory_hook: toward the vehicle behind the space

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After your front clears the vehicle ahead, steer sharply left and continue reversing ____.
cards.back: After your front clears the vehicle ahead, steer sharply left and continue reversing slowly until near the vehicle behind.
cards.memory_hook: slowly until near the vehicle behind

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Finish parallel parking by straightening the wheels, moving forward to center the vehicle, selecting Park, applying the ____.
cards.back: Finish parallel parking by straightening the wheels, moving forward to center the vehicle, selecting Park, applying the brake and shutting off the engine.
cards.memory_hook: brake and shutting off the engine

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leaving the keys in a running unattended ____.
cards.back: Leaving the keys in a running unattended vehicle is unlawful.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle is unlawful

decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For parallel parking at a one-way street’s left curb, reverse the right and ____.
cards.back: For parallel parking at a one-way street’s left curb, reverse the right and left directions in the parking procedure.
cards.memory_hook: left directions in the parking procedure

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in low gear when ____.
cards.back: Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in low gear when parked facing uphill.
cards.memory_hook: parked facing uphill

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in reverse when ____.
cards.back: Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in reverse when parked facing downhill.
cards.memory_hook: parked facing downhill

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before leaving a parallel-parking space, signal, check traffic, steer toward the open ____.
cards.back: Before leaving a parallel-parking space, signal, check traffic, steer toward the open lane and move out gradually.
cards.memory_hook: lane and move out gradually

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A designated accessible parking space requires either a displayed rear accessible plate or a parking ID ____.
cards.back: A designated accessible parking space requires either a displayed rear accessible plate or a parking ID card hanging at the rear-view mirror.
cards.memory_hook: card hanging at the rear-view mirror

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A vehicle parked along a highway from sunset to sunrise must display parking ____.
cards.back: A vehicle parked along a highway from sunset to sunrise must display parking lights or, if equipped, four-way flashers.
cards.memory_hook: lights or, if equipped, four-way flashers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Parking lights or equipped four-way flashers are also required along a highway when light is inadequate to see people ____.
cards.back: Parking lights or equipped four-way flashers are also required along a highway when light is inadequate to see people or objects one thousand feet away.
cards.memory_hook: or objects one thousand feet away

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A parked vehicle must not flash turn signals ____.
cards.back: A parked vehicle must not flash turn signals on just one side.
cards.memory_hook: on just one side

decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Outside a business or residential area, do not park on a highway’s paved or traveled portion unless the vehicle is disabled and immovable; ____.
cards.back: Outside a business or residential area, do not park on a highway’s paved or traveled portion unless the vehicle is disabled and immovable; move as far right as possible.
cards.memory_hook: move as far right as possible

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For downhill parking, turn the front wheels toward the ____.
cards.back: For downhill parking, turn the front wheels toward the curb or roadway edge.
cards.memory_hook: curb or roadway edge

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For uphill parking beside a curb, turn the front wheels away from it and bring the ____.
cards.back: For uphill parking beside a curb, turn the front wheels away from it and bring the nearer front wheel against the curb.
cards.memory_hook: nearer front wheel against the curb

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For uphill parking without a curb, turn the front wheels ____.
cards.back: For uphill parking without a curb, turn the front wheels toward the highway edge.
cards.memory_hook: toward the highway edge

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not open a parked vehicle’s door into traffic or danger; use the curb-side door when possible and check for approaching vehicles and ____.
cards.back: Do not open a parked vehicle’s door into traffic or danger; use the curb-side door when possible and check for approaching vehicles and cyclists before using the street-side door.
cards.memory_hook: cyclists before using the street-side door

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The stopping-and-parking prohibitions allow exceptions for contrary postings, police orders or crash avoidance, and apply even ____.
cards.back: The stopping-and-parking prohibitions allow exceptions for contrary postings, police orders or crash avoidance, and apply even when someone remains in the vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: when someone remains in the vehicle

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park where ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park where an official sign forbids it.
cards.memory_hook: an official sign forbids it

decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park beside a yellow-painted ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park beside a yellow-painted curb or a yellow road-edge line.
cards.memory_hook: curb or a yellow road-edge line

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking is barred within an intersection, directly on its crosswalk, and ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking is barred within an intersection, directly on its crosswalk, and for twenty feet from that crosswalk.
cards.memory_hook: for twenty feet from that crosswalk

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking on ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking on a sidewalk is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: a sidewalk is prohibited

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park in front of a road, alley ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park in front of a road, alley or driveway, whether public or private.
cards.memory_hook: or driveway, whether public or private

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, remain at least fifteen feet from a ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, remain at least fifteen feet from a hydrant when stopping or parking.
cards.memory_hook: hydrant when stopping or parking

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park within twenty ____.
cards.back: Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway entrance.
cards.memory_hook: feet of a fire-station driveway entrance

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: With signs posted, the stopping-and-parking restriction across from a fire-station entrance extends seventy-five ____.
cards.back: With signs posted, the stopping-and-parking restriction across from a fire-station entrance extends seventy-five feet, subject to the stated exceptions.
cards.memory_hook: feet, subject to the stated exceptions

decks.module: Restricted locations and stated speed limits (A)
decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued stopping-and-parking prohibition list includes the area within thirty feet of a flashing ____.
cards.back: The continued stopping-and-parking prohibition list includes the area within thirty feet of a flashing beacon, stop sign or traffic signal.
cards.memory_hook: beacon, stop sign or traffic signal

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes the space between a safety island or zone and the curb, plus the area within thirty feet ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes the space between a safety island or zone and the curb, plus the area within thirty feet of its end unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: of its end unless posted otherwise

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes locations within fifty feet of a rail ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes locations within fifty feet of a rail crossing unless signs state otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: crossing unless signs state otherwise

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes parking or stopping beside or opposite a road excavation or ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes parking or stopping beside or opposite a road excavation or obstruction when traffic would be impeded.
cards.memory_hook: obstruction when traffic would be impeded

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes the roadway side of a vehicle already ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes the roadway side of a vehicle already stopped or parked at the curb.
cards.memory_hook: stopped or parked at the curb

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes highway bridges, elevated ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes highway bridges, elevated structures and tunnels.
cards.memory_hook: structures and tunnels

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes any place where stopping, standing ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes any place where stopping, standing or parking obstructs traffic flow.
cards.memory_hook: or parking obstructs traffic flow

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes the area between ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes the area between divided-highway roadways, including crossovers.
cards.memory_hook: divided-highway roadways, including crossovers

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The continued prohibition list includes designated ____.
cards.back: The continued prohibition list includes designated fire lanes.
cards.memory_hook: fire lanes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware drivers must satisfy both the general reasonable-speed restriction ____.
cards.back: Delaware drivers must satisfy both the general reasonable-speed restriction and specific speed limits.
cards.memory_hook: and specific speed limits

decks.module: Restricted locations and stated speed limits (B)
decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drive no faster than is reasonable for the actual conditions, even when that ____.
cards.back: Drive no faster than is reasonable for the actual conditions, even when that requires traveling below the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: requires traveling below the posted limit

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Control vehicle speed to avoid striking people, vehicles or other conveyances regardless of ____.
cards.back: Control vehicle speed to avoid striking people, vehicles or other conveyances regardless of weather, traffic density or personal urgency.
cards.memory_hook: weather, traffic density or personal urgency

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Emergency conditions can change the table’s speed limits, and the posted ____.
cards.back: Emergency conditions can change the table’s speed limits, and the posted limit must never be exceeded.
cards.memory_hook: limit must never be exceeded

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook’s table lists twenty miles per hour in school zones, with a footnote referring to the code ____.
cards.back: The handbook’s table lists twenty miles per hour in school zones, with a footnote referring to the code definition of when children are present.
cards.memory_hook: definition of when children are present

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The speed table lists twenty-five miles per hour for business districts, subject to ____.
cards.back: The speed table lists twenty-five miles per hour for business districts, subject to emergency changes and the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: emergency changes and the posted limit

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The speed table lists twenty-five miles per hour for residential districts, subject to ____.
cards.back: The speed table lists twenty-five miles per hour for residential districts, subject to emergency changes and the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: emergency changes and the posted limit

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The speed table lists fifty miles per hour for two-lane roads, subject to ____.
cards.back: The speed table lists fifty miles per hour for two-lane roads, subject to emergency changes and the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: emergency changes and the posted limit

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The speed table lists fifty-five miles per hour for divided roads and roads with at least four lanes, subject ____.
cards.back: The speed table lists fifty-five miles per hour for divided roads and roads with at least four lanes, subject to emergency changes and posted limits.
cards.memory_hook: to emergency changes and posted limits

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The table lists fifty-five miles per hour for controlled-access highways such as expressways and turnpikes, subject ____.
cards.back: The table lists fifty-five miles per hour for controlled-access highways such as expressways and turnpikes, subject to emergency changes and posted limits.
cards.memory_hook: to emergency changes and posted limits

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The table lists sixty-five miles per hour for Route one and Interstate four hundred ninety-five, subject to ____.
cards.back: The table lists sixty-five miles per hour for Route one and Interstate four hundred ninety-five, subject to emergency changes and the posted limit.
cards.memory_hook: emergency changes and the posted limit

decks.module: Conditions, speed choice and prohibited movement
decks.domain: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Speed limits that are unsafe for prevailing conditions may be reduced, with ____.
cards.back: Speed limits that are unsafe for prevailing conditions may be reduced, with signs showing the lower limit.
cards.memory_hook: signs showing the lower limit

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not travel so slowly that normal reasonable traffic is obstructed, unless safety ____.
cards.back: Do not travel so slowly that normal reasonable traffic is obstructed, unless safety or legal compliance requires that speed.
cards.memory_hook: or legal compliance requires that speed

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Follow posted minimum speeds unless weather or other conditions ____.
cards.back: Follow posted minimum speeds unless weather or other conditions make doing so unsafe.
cards.memory_hook: make doing so unsafe

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Legal speed-limit signs use black lettering and numerals ____.
cards.back: Legal speed-limit signs use black lettering and numerals on white rectangles.
cards.memory_hook: on white rectangles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Advisory-speed signs use black lettering on yellow and often ____.
cards.back: Advisory-speed signs use black lettering on yellow and often appear below warning signs.
cards.memory_hook: appear below warning signs

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An advisory speed is not a specific limit, but exceeding it and crashing can support a finding that ____.
cards.back: An advisory speed is not a specific limit, but exceeding it and crashing can support a finding that the general speed restriction was violated.
cards.memory_hook: the general speed restriction was violated

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Motorists share highways with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists, animal riders or drivers, and ____.
cards.back: Motorists share highways with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists, animal riders or drivers, and farm, road or construction machinery operators.
cards.memory_hook: farm, road or construction machinery operators

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers, pedestrians and bicyclists must all ____.
cards.back: Drivers, pedestrians and bicyclists must all follow traffic laws.
cards.memory_hook: follow traffic laws

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Stop for a pedestrian actively crossing a marked or unmarked crosswalk; cautious progress is permitted when the pedestrian remains safely stopped on ____.
cards.back: Stop for a pedestrian actively crossing a marked or unmarked crosswalk; cautious progress is permitted when the pedestrian remains safely stopped on the sidewalk as required by law.
cards.memory_hook: the sidewalk as required by law

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Sounding the horn does not replace the duty ____.
cards.back: Sounding the horn does not replace the duty to yield to pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: to yield to pedestrians

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Be alert and yield to pedestrians with hearing impairments or physical disabilities using mobility aids or service ____.
cards.back: Be alert and yield to pedestrians with hearing impairments or physical disabilities using mobility aids or service animals, allowing for additional crossing time.
cards.memory_hook: animals, allowing for additional crossing time

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not drive through a pedestrian safety zone ____.
cards.back: Do not drive through a pedestrian safety zone or block a crosswalk.
cards.memory_hook: or block a crosswalk
